purpose: Continuation of the country x subject occupation-salary research matrix. Same integrity rule: only occupation- or occupation-class-level sources from an OFFICIAL statistics publisher may populate a subject figure. Employer/survey sites (StepStone, kununu, PayScale, SEEK, Indeed, SalaryExpert/ERI, Jobted, Glassdoor, Randstad, Adzuna) are AGGREGATOR/CROWDSOURCED and are NEVER recorded as official, even when convenient.

nl-cbs-odata-85517ned.publisher: Statistics Netherlands (CBS) - StatLine table 85517NED (uurloonpercentielen per beroep, preliminary)
nl-cbs-odata-85517ned.occupation_code_system: CBS occupation class 0811 Software- en applicatieontwikkelaars
nl-cbs-odata-85517ned.extraction_note: Figure located via a secondary page that cites the exact CBS OData table; marked for primary confirmation against CBS StatLine before corpus promotion. Gross monthly/overtime-excluded; holiday allowance and allowances not included.

de-ba-entgeltatlas.publisher: Bundesagentur für Arbeit - Entgeltatlas (Statistik der Bundesagentur für Arbeit)
de-ba-entgeltatlas.extraction_note: Official occupation-class monthly gross medians (employees subject to social insurance, full-time), derived from reported social-insurance earnings. The web tool is JavaScript-rendered; the exact figure per occupation class was NOT retrieved in this tranche. Employer/survey figures for German software developers (StepStone EUR 50,300; kununu EUR 60,900; profiling-institut EUR 72,000) are AGGREGATOR/CROWDSOURCED and are deliberately NOT recorded.

au-jsa-osca-2026-04.note: Employment counts by occupation are published; median weekly earnings are not produced for many detailed occupations.

claims.occupation_label: Software- en applicatieontwikkelaars (software and application developers)
claims.statement: In the Netherlands, software and application developers (CBS occupation class 0811) had a median gross monthly wage of about EUR 6,032 at a 40-hour week (about EUR 72,384 per year), with the 25th-75th percentile band of about EUR 4,680 to EUR 7,523 per month, from CBS StatLine wage percentiles (preliminary).
